# Adedayo Ebenezer Oyetoke

> Adedayo Ebenezer Oyetoke is a full-stack Laravel developer and founder of Wireless Computer Services. This website presents his portfolio, website development services, pricing, technical stack, selected projects, and public contact information for clients and employers worldwide.
